title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Standard and Basic licensed devices in the Pro Management portal
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licence requirements and licence-assignment controls are supported. The inventory path stops on the correct page but should end at License Type, and the cloud-coverage paragraph should acknowledge Microsoft's conflicting DoD portal guidance.

claims.claim: The Pro Management portal supports Teams Rooms on Windows devices with Standard or Basic licences.
claims.quote: The Teams Rooms Pro Management portal now supports and enforces licenses for devices in Teams Rooms on Windows with a Standard or Basic license.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A room's licence is assigned in Microsoft 365 admin center through Users > Active users > room account > Licenses and apps > Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro or Microsoft Teams Rooms Basic.
claims.quote: Go to **Users** > **Active users**, and select the room you created to open the properties panel. In the panel, select **Licenses and apps**. ... Check the box next to **Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro** or **Microsoft Teams Rooms Basic**

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: POST /v1.0/users/{id | userPrincipalName}/assignLicense adds or removes a resource account's licences.
claims.quote: Add or remove licenses for the user ... POST /users/{id | userPrincipalName}/assignLicense ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/assignLicense

claims.claim: The assignLicense request body uses addLicenses for licences to add.
claims.quote: addLicenses ... A collection of assignedLicense objects that specify the licenses to add.

claims.claim: The assignLicense request body uses removeLicenses for licences to remove.
claims.quote: removeLicenses ... A collection of skuIds that identify the licenses to remove. Required. Can be an empty collection.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The licence inventory is reached in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal through Planning > Inventory.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal. Select **Planning** then **Inventory** in the left navigation pane.
claims.fix: Complete controls[1].ui.path and the corresponding table route as 'Planning > Inventory > resource account > License Type'. The resource account step means finding the device's assigned account, not opening it. Set docs to https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/custom-backgrounds, which explicitly gives these licence-check steps and is already cited.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an API or automation equivalent for the portal's per-device License Type status view.
claims.quote: Searched: Pro Management License Type API; Teams PowerShell Graph teamDevice license status Syncing Unlicensed Basic Standard. Read inventory, rooms-licensing and Graph teamworkDevice reference; user-license results do not document the portal's device-status view.

claims.claim: The License Type column displays licence status rather than assigning a licence.
claims.quote: In both views, locate the **License Type** column to see device licensing status.
